# Pixel Coin Clicker

A simple offline clicker game built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

## How to Play

- Click the big coin to earn points.
- Buy an Auto-clicker for 10 points. Each Auto-clicker adds 1 point per second.
- The price of the next Auto-clicker doubles after each purchase.

## Controls

- **Coin button**: Click or press Enter/Space to earn points.
- **Buy Auto-clicker button**: Click or press Enter/Space to purchase (enabled only when you have enough points).

## Running the Game

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or internet connection required.

## Files

- `index.html` – Game markup
- `style.css` – Visual styling
- `game.js` – Game logic
